mapper.select: select count(1) as totalClient, sum(case when attr1 = '已成交' then 1 else 0 end) as completeClient, sum(case when attr1 != '已成交' or attr1 is null then 1 else 0 end) as potentialClient, sum(case when contact2 = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as normalClient, sum(case when contact2 = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as importanceClient, sum(case when contact2 = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as strategyClient from crm_client where is_deleted = 0

select CASE WHEN lead_source is null THEN '未知' WHEN lead_source = '1' THEN '电话来访' WHEN lead_source = '2' THEN '客户介绍' WHEN lead_source = '3' THEN '上门拜访' WHEN lead_source = '4' THEN '销售自拓' WHEN lead_source = '5' THEN '其他' END as leadSource, count(1) as totalClient from crm_client where is_deleted = 0 group by lead_source
select attr1 as status, count(1) as totalClient from crm_client where is_deleted = 0 group by attr1

SELECT s.name AS provinceName, -- 省份名称 IFNULL(COUNT(c.id), 0) AS customerCount -- 客户数量，如果没有则显示0 FROM sys_area s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, CASE WHEN LOCATE('省', address) > 0 THEN LEFT(address, LOCATE('省', address)) WHEN LOCATE('自治区', address) > 0 THEN LEFT(address, LOCATE('自治区', address) + 2) WHEN LOCATE('市', address) > 0 THEN LEFT(address, LOCATE('市', address)) ELSE address END AS province_name FROM crm_client where is_deleted = 0 ) c ON s.name = c.province_name where s.level = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY s.name
